description: The bar chart illustrates evaluation scores for a text generation diffusion language model across different diffusion steps, showing multiple ROUGE metrics per step. The horizontal axis contains the categorical diffusion-step settings labeled 100, 250, 500, 1000, and 2000 (in increasing order) with the axis label “Diffusion Step,” and the vertical axis represents the ROUGE score values (numeric labels are shown above bars, but the y-axis itself has no visible tick labels or explicit range markings). For each diffusion step, three adjacent bars are shown as a grouped set: a blue diagonally hatched bar for ROUGE-1, a light teal diagonally hatched bar for ROUGE-2, and an orange diagonally hatched bar for a third ROUGE metric (legend swatch shown but label not readable). At diffusion step 100, the bars are approximately 6.3 (ROUGE-1, blue), 0.1 (ROUGE-2, teal), and 3.0 (orange); at 250 they are about 11.6 (blue), 0.4 (teal), and 8.3 (orange); at 500 they are about 21.1 (blue), 4.1 (teal), and 15.9 (orange); at 1000 they are about 38.3 (blue), 16.5 (teal), and 30.7 (orange); and at 2000 they are about 41.2 (blue), 19.1 (teal), and 33.4 (orange). The bars are not sorted by value but are arranged by the diffusion-step categories, and there are no additional visual emphases such as outlines, annotations beyond the numeric value labels, or stacked components.
